title: Unbelievable buggy and trancated
body:
I can’t believe how useless this app is.

The craziest example is that there’s no way to “special paste values”.
Arrows are broken: when editing cell value, left and right work as supposed to, while up and down move you to another cell, even if the current cell is multiline!
There’s no way to add a line break to a cell’s value.
When writing formula, you can’t add ranges except for writing the coordinates character by character.
Writing formula and tapping on one cell adds its coordinate, then tapping on another one… adds that as a second parameter instead of replacing the first one!
Pressing enter when editing formula doesn’t close your parenthesis and quotes, unlike browser version.

I could continue this list infinitely. This app lacks a huge chunk of the most basic functionality. But I’ll just say: if you, like me, use Google Sheets daily for your job, then just use Safari browser, and never install this app. Safari, not Chrome, because Chrome even doesn’t allow to edit the sheets at all! In Safari, Sheets are actually useable.

Just in case if it helps: I’m using iPad 9th generation.
